type Query {
  account(id: String!): Account
  accounts: [Account!]!
  address(id: String!): Address!
  addresses: Address!
  areaAsset(id: String!): AreaAsset
  areaAssets: [AreaAsset!]!
  areaTypeOnPattern(id: String!): AreaTypeOnPattern
  areaTypeOnPatterns: [AreaTypeOnPattern!]!
  areaTypeOnProject(id: String!): AreaTypeOnProject
  areaTypeOnProjects(projectId: String!): [AreaTypeOnProject!]!
  areaTypeTemplate(id: String!): AreaTypeTemplate
  areaTypeTemplates: [AreaTypeTemplate!]!
  asset(id: String!): Asset
  assetValue(id: ID!): AssetValue
  assetValues(assetId: String!): [AssetValue!]!
  """
  Returns assets for a given portfolio. Does not return relations for better performance. For detailed asset information use assetsById endpoint.
  """
  assets(filterProfile: JSON, filterSearch: String, portfolioId: String!): [Asset!]!
  assetsById(assetIds: [String!], portfolioId: String!): [Asset!]!
  assetsWithinBounds(bounds: GeoBounds!, filterProfile: JSON, filterSearch: String, portfolioId: String!): [Asset!]!
  audit(id: String!): Audit
  audits(entries: [AuditEntry!], page: Int!): FilteredAudits!
  building(id: String!): Building
  buildings(portfolioId: String): [Building!]!
  buildingsWithinBounds(bounds: GeoBounds!): [Building!]!
  closestWeatherDataset(lat: Float!, lng: Float!): WeatherDataset!
  comment(id: String!): Comment
  comments(discussionId: String!): [Comment!]!
  contact(id: String!): Contact
  contacts(page: Int, sortingDirection: String, sortingProperty: String): FilteredContacts
  contextBuildings: [ContextBuilding!]!
  dataCatalog(id: String!): DataCatalog
  dataCatalogs: [DataCatalog!]!
  discussion(id: String!): Discussion
  discussions(threadId: String!): [Discussion!]!
  enquiries(filter: JSON, page: Int, portfolioId: String!, sortingDirection: String, sortingProperty: String): FilteredEnquiries!
  enquiry(id: String!, portfolioId: String!): Enquiry
  exportEnquiriesReport(endDate: DateTime!, portfolioId: String!, startDate: DateTime!): EnquiriesReport!
  exportThreads(threadIds: [String!]!): String
  exposeTemplate(id: String!): ExposeTemplate
  exposeTemplates(id: String!, model: ExposeTemplateModel!): [ExposeTemplate!]!
  featureSet(id: String!): FeatureSet
  featureSets: [FeatureSet!]!
  file(id: String!): File
  files(relation: FileRelation!, relationId: String!): [File!]!
  filterProfile(id: String!): FilterProfile
  filterProfiles(portfolioId: String!): [FilterProfile!]!
  general: General
  geoDataSource(id: String!): GeoDataSource
  geoDataSourceOnAsset(assetId: String!, sourceId: String!): GeoDataSourceOnAsset
  geoDataSourceOnAssets(assetId: String!): [GeoDataSourceOnAsset!]!
  geoDataSourceOnView(id: String!): GeoDataSourceOnView
  geoDataSourceOnViews(viewId: String!): [GeoDataSourceOnView!]!
  geoDataSourceProxies: [GeoDataSourceProxy!]!
  geoDataSourceProxy(id: String!): GeoDataSourceProxy
